text: [125] pañcime bhikkhave dhammā anāyussā katame pañca asappāyakārī hoti sappāye mattaṃ na jānāti apariṇatabhojī ca hoti akālacārī ca abrahmacārī ca ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā anāyussā 2 . pañcime bhikkhave dhammā āyussā katame pañca0 sappāyakārī hoti sappāye mattaṃ jānāti pariṇatabhojī ca hoti kālacārī ca brahmacārī ca ime kho bhikkhave pañca dhammā āyussāti .
